title: Construction timeline
completionHint: Passing the planned end does not automatically complete work.
plannedHint: Ranges and waiting periods are planned, not a guarantee of actual completion.
incomplete: Schedule incomplete: task start or prerequisite end is missing.

deleteLinks: Delete? These tasks will lose this prerequisite: {{names}}. Their other prerequisites will remain.

outside: Linked work may be outside the visible range or filter.
parallelHint: Parallel work is not automatically a conflict.
